questions.q: Which country won the first World Cup in 1930?
Which country has won the most World Cups?
Who scored a hat-trick in a World Cup final?
questions.explanation: Hurst's hat-trick for England vs West Germany in 1966.

questions.q: Who scored a hat-trick in the 2022 World Cup final?
questions.explanation: Mbappé scored 3 in the final, on the losing side.

questions.q: What was the result of the 1950 World Cup decisive match (Maracanazo)?
questions.explanation: Uruguay beat hosts Brazil 2-1 to win the Cup.

questions.q: Who is the only player to win three World Cups?
Which is the only country to host AND win the World Cup in different decades?
questions.explanation: Uruguay hosted+won in 1930 and won again in 1950.

questions.q: How many continents have produced World Cup winners?
questions.explanation: Only Europe and South America have produced winners.

questions.q: Who won the Golden Boot at the 2018 World Cup?
Which country has been the runner-up the most times without winning the World Cup?
questions.explanation: The Netherlands have finished runner-up three times.
